summary_en: ¥10.00/share (¥5.00 ordinary + ¥5.00 special anniversary), total ¥309M, record date 2026-08-31, effective date 2026-10-26. Full-year dividend ¥15.00/share vs. ¥10.00 prior year.
title_en: Notice regarding 50th Anniversary Special Dividend (Revision of Dividend Forecast)
translation_en_brief: Joyful announced a 50th anniversary special dividend on 2026-08-10. The company's board resolved to pay a total dividend of ¥10.00 per share for the year ending 2026-06-30, consisting of ¥5.00 ordinary dividend and ¥5.00 special anniversary dividend. The record date is 2026-08-31, with an effective date of 2026-10-26. Total dividend payout is ¥309 million. This represents an upward revision from the forecast announced on 2025-08-12 (which projected ¥5.00/share). Full-year dividend for FY2026 is thus ¥15.00/share, compared to ¥10.00/share in the prior fiscal year. The dividend is funded from retained earnings and was authorized by board resolution under the company's articles of incorporation, which permit dividend determination without shareholder meeting approval.
